title: Scribbler Box Alternatives: 4 Picks for Writers - Cratejoy
summary: Compare four Scribbler alternatives for fiction writers, from a monthly prompt-and-workbook box to a novel-in-a-year plan, a writing magazine, and notebooks.
body_markdown:
Craft lessons and publishing advice


### Writer’s Digest vs Scribbler


**Best for:** The writer who reads the “Publishing Process Inside Look” card before anything else in a Scribbler box.


[Writer’s Digest](https://subscriptions.writersdigest.com/) is the one magazine on this list. Each issue mixes technique articles and exercises for fiction, nonfiction, and poetry with the business side: writing queries, finding markets, submission guidelines, and contests.


#### What feels familiar


Advice from people who work in publishing, the part of Scribbler that the agent chats and inside-look cards cover.


#### What changes


No book and no gifts, and six issues a year instead of twelve boxes. You can cancel anytime and get a refund for issues not yet mailed.
